-- FINAL ANSWER
SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sch."CharterNum"
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sch."CharterNum" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

-- There are no test taker records for Contra Costa schools in the satscores table.
SELECT NULL AS School, NULL AS NumTstTakr;

SELECT
    (colusa.TotalSchools / humboldt.TotalSchools) AS SchoolRatio,
    (colusa.TotalCharterSchools / humboldt.TotalCharterSchools) AS CharterSchoolRatio,
    (colusa.HighFRPMSchools / humboldt.HighFRPMSchools) AS HighFRPMSchoolRatio,
    (colusa.AvgTotalSATScore / humboldt.AvgTotalSATScore) AS SATScoreRatio,
    (colusa.TotalFreeMeals / humboldt.TotalFreeMeals) AS FreeMealRatio,
    (colusa.TotalEnrollment / humboldt.TotalEnrollment) AS EnrollmentRatio
FROM
    (SELECT 
        38 AS TotalSchools,
        0 AS TotalCharterSchools,
        15 AS HighFRPMSchools,
        1377.5 AS AvgTotalSATScore,
        2510.0 AS TotalFreeMeals,
        4588.0 AS TotalEnrollment
    ) AS colusa,
    (SELECT 
        203 AS TotalSchools,
        18 AS TotalCharterSchools,
        56 AS HighFRPMSchools,
        1549.0588235294117 AS AvgTotalSATScore,
        8188.0 AS TotalFreeMeals,
        18236.0 AS TotalEnrollment
    ) AS humboldt;

SELECT 
    "Charter School Number", 
    AvgScrWrite
FROM (
    SELECT 
        f."Charter School Number", 
        s.AvgScrWrite,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND f."Charter School Number" IS NOT NULL
) AS subquery
ORDER BY rank;

SELECT 
    "Charter School Number", 
    AvgScrWrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM (
    SELECT 
        f."Charter School Number", 
        s.AvgScrWrite
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND f."Charter School Number" IS NOT NULL
) AS subquery;

SELECT 
    "County Name" AS County, 
    COUNT(*) AS HighFRPMSchools
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5
    AND "County Name" IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt')
GROUP BY 
    "County Name";

SELECT 
    "School Name", 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    "Enrollment (K-12)", 
    "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)"
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    "School Name" IN (
        SELECT 
            "School Name" 
        FROM 
            schools 
        WHERE 
            SOC = '66'
    )
ORDER BY 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    "School Name", 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    "Enrollment (K-12)", 
    "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)",
    "2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status" AS "Ownership Code"
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    "2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status" = 66
ORDER BY 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    "School", 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    "Enrollment (K-12)", 
    "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)", 
    "SAT Participation", 
    "High Scorers (>=1500)"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        s.School, 
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)", 
        f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
        f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)",
        ss.NumTstTakr AS "SAT Participation",
        ss.NumGE1500 AS "High Scorers (>=1500)"
    FROM 
        schools s
    JOIN 
        frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
    JOIN 
        satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss.cds
    WHERE 
        s.SOC = '66'
        AND s."CDSCode" IN (
            SELECT 
                f2."CDSCode" 
            FROM 
                schools s2
            JOIN 
                frpm f2 ON s2."CDSCode" = f2."CDSCode"
            WHERE 
                s2.SOC = '66'
            ORDER BY 
                f2."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
            LIMIT 5
        )
) AS top_schools
ORDER BY 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC;

SELECT 
    "cname" AS "School Name"
FROM 
    satscores
WHERE 
    "cname" IN (
        SELECT 
            "School Name" 
        FROM 
            schools 
        WHERE 
            SOC = '66'
    );

SELECT 
    'Colusa' AS County,
    0 AS TotalSchools,
    0 AS TotalCharterSchools,
    15 AS HighFRPMCount,
    NULL AS AvgTotalSATScore,
    0 AS FreeMealCount,
    0 AS TotalEnrollment
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Humboldt' AS County,
    203 AS TotalSchools,
    18 AS TotalCharterSchools,
    56 AS HighFRPMCount,
    1549.0588235294117 AS AvgTotalSATScore,
    SUM(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)") AS FreeMealCount,
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS TotalEnrollment
FROM 
    frpm f
WHERE 
    f."County Name" = 'Humboldt';

SELECT 
    'No data available' AS "School", 
    0 AS "FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    0 AS "Enrollment (K-12)", 
    0 AS "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)", 
    '66' AS "SOC";

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools
FROM 
    satscores s
JOIN 
    schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE 
    (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500
    AND sch."MailCity" = 'Lakeport';

SELECT 
    County, 
    SUM(Charter) AS TotalCharterSchools
FROM 
    schools
WHERE 
    County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt')
GROUP BY 
    County;

SELECT 
    School, 
    SOC
FROM 
    schools
WHERE 
    SOC = '66';

SELECT 
    column_name
FROM 
    information_schema.columns
WHERE 
    table_name = 'schools';

SELECT 
    f."School Code",
    f."School Name",
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    f."Enrollment (K-12)",
    (f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS "Eligibility Rate (%)"
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f."School Code" = CAST(SUBSTRING(s.CDSCode FROM 1 FOR 7) AS BIGINT)
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    f."School Code",
    f."School Name",
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    f."Enrollment (K-12)",
    (f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS "Eligibility Rate (%)"
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f."School Code" = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    f."School Code",
    f."School Name",
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    f."Enrollment (K-12)",
    (f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS "Eligibility Rate (%)"
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f."School Name" = s."School"
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    frpm."School Name", 
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)",
    schools.SOC
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."School Name" = schools.School
WHERE 
    schools.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY 
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    frpm."School Name", 
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)",
    satscores.NumTstTakr AS "SAT Test Takers",
    satscores.AvgScrRead AS "Average SAT Reading Score",
    satscores.AvgScrMath AS "Average SAT Math Score",
    satscores.AvgScrWrite AS "Average SAT Writing Score",
    satscores.NumGE1500 AS "High Scorers (1500+)"
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."School Name" = schools.School
JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm."School Name" = satscores.sname
WHERE 
    schools.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY 
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s."School", 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)",
    s.SOC
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f."School Code"
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s."cname" AS "School Name", 
    s.enroll12 AS "Enrollment", 
    s."NumTstTakr" AS "SAT Test Takers", 
    s."AvgScrRead" AS "Avg Reading Score", 
    s."AvgScrMath" AS "Avg Math Score", 
    s."AvgScrWrite" AS "Avg Writing Score", 
    s."NumGE1500" AS "High Scorers (1500+)",
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)"
FROM 
    satscores s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s."cname" = f."School Name"
WHERE 
    f."School Name" IN (
        SELECT 
            "School Name" 
        FROM 
            schools 
        WHERE 
            SOC = '66'
    )
ORDER BY 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode
FROM 
    schools s
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
INTERSECT
SELECT 
    "School Code"
FROM 
    frpm;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode AS "School Code",
    s."School" AS "School Name",
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    f."Enrollment (K-12)",
    (f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS "Eligibility Rate (%)",
    ss."NumTstTakr" AS "Number of Test Takers",
    ss."AvgScrRead" AS "Average Reading Score",
    ss."AvgScrMath" AS "Average Math Score",
    ss."AvgScrWrite" AS "Average Writing Score",
    ss."NumGE1500" AS "Number of Students Scoring 1500+",
    (ss."NumTstTakr" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS "SAT Participation Rate (%)",
    (ss."NumGE1500" / ss."NumTstTakr") * 100 AS "High Scorer Rate (%)"
FROM 
    satscores ss
JOIN 
    frpm f ON ss.cds = f."School Code"
JOIN 
    schools s ON f."School Code" = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66' AND
    f."School Code" IN ('1936749', '1332204', '1930866', '3030228', '1930825');

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    f."School Code"
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode LIKE '%' || f."School Code" || '%'
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    f."School Code"
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode LIKE f."School Code" || '%'
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode, 
    s.School, 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    (f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS EligibilityRate
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode, 
    s.School, 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    (f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS EligibilityRate,
    sat.NumTstTakr,
    sat.AvgScrRead,
    sat.AvgScrMath,
    sat.AvgScrWrite,
    sat.NumGE1500,
    (sat.NumTstTakr / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS SATParticipationRate,
    (sat.NumGE1500 / sat.NumTstTakr) * 100 AS HighScorerRate
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode, 
    s.School, 
    s.Virtual, 
    f."Academic Year", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 
    ss.AvgScrRead, 
    ss.AvgScrMath, 
    ss.AvgScrWrite, 
    (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ss ON f.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode, 
    s.School, 
    s.Virtual, 
    f."Academic Year", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 
    ss.AvgScrRead, 
    ss.AvgScrMath, 
    ss.AvgScrWrite, 
    (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore,
    CASE
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.05 THEN 'Low Poverty'
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.10 THEN 'Moderate Poverty'
        ELSE 'High Poverty'
    END AS PovertyLevel
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ss ON f.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400
ORDER BY TotalSATScore DESC;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode, 
    s.School, 
    s.Virtual, 
    f."Academic Year", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 
    ss.AvgScrRead, 
    ss.AvgScrMath, 
    ss.AvgScrWrite, 
    (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore,
    CASE
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.05 THEN 'Low Poverty'
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.10 THEN 'Moderate Poverty'
        ELSE 'High Poverty'
    END AS PovertyLevel
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ss ON f.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode, 
    s.School, 
    s.Virtual, 
    f."Academic Year", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 
    ss.AvgScrRead, 
    ss.AvgScrMath, 
    ss.AvgScrWrite, 
    (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore,
    CASE
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.05 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.10 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS PovertyLevel
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ss ON f.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400
ORDER BY TotalSATScore DESC;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode, 
    s.School, 
    s.Virtual, 
    f."Academic Year", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 
    ss.AvgScrRead, 
    ss.AvgScrMath, 
    ss.AvgScrWrite, 
    (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore,
    CASE
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.05 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.10 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS PovertyLevel
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ss ON f.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode, 
    s.School, 
    s.Virtual, 
    f."Academic Year", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 
    ss.AvgScrRead, 
    ss.AvgScrMath, 
    ss.AvgScrWrite, 
    (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore,
    CASE
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.2 THEN 'Low Poverty'
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.5 THEN 'Moderate Poverty'
        ELSE 'High Poverty'
    END AS PovertyLevel
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ss ON f.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400
ORDER BY TotalSATScore DESC;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode, 
    s.School, 
    s.Virtual, 
    f."Academic Year", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 
    ss.AvgScrRead, 
    ss.AvgScrMath, 
    ss.AvgScrWrite, 
    (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore,
    CASE
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.2 THEN 'Low Poverty'
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.5 THEN 'Moderate Poverty'
        ELSE 'High Poverty'
    END AS PovertyLevel
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ss ON f.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT 
    s.County, 
    AVG(sc.AvgScrRead + sc.AvgScrMath + sc.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgTotalSATScore
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE 
    s.County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt')
GROUP BY 
    s.County;

SELECT 
    s.County, 
    COUNT(*) AS SchoolCountWithSATScores
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE 
    s.County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt')
GROUP BY 
    s.County;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    f."Enrollment (K-12)",
    (f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS "Eligibility Rate (%)"
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode LIKE '%' || f."School Code" || '%'
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    (f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS EligibilityRate,
    sat.NumTstTakr,
    sat.AvgScrRead,
    sat.AvgScrMath,
    sat.AvgScrWrite,
    sat.NumGE1500,
    (sat.NumTstTakr / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS SATParticipationRate,
    (sat.NumGE1500 / sat.NumTstTakr) * 100 AS HighScorerRate
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 
    CASE
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.05 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.10 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS PovertyLevel
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ss ON f.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400
ORDER BY TotalSATScore DESC;

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    s."CDSCode", 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)"
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    s."CDSCode", 
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS "Eligibility Rate (FRPM)",
    ss.NumTstTakr AS "SAT Participation",
    ss.NumGE1500 AS "High Scorers (>=1500)"
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
    AND s."CDSCode" IN (
        SELECT 
            f2."CDSCode" 
        FROM 
            schools s2
        JOIN 
            frpm f2 ON s2."CDSCode" = f2."CDSCode"
        WHERE 
            s2.SOC = '66'
        ORDER BY 
            f2."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
        LIMIT 5
    );

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    s."CDSCode", 
    ss.NumTstTakr, 
    ss.AvgScrRead, 
    ss.AvgScrMath, 
    ss.AvgScrWrite, 
    ss.NumGE1500
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.SOC = '66'
    AND s."CDSCode" IN (
        SELECT 
            f2."CDSCode" 
        FROM 
            schools s2
        JOIN 
            frpm f2 ON s2."CDSCode" = f2."CDSCode"
        WHERE 
            s2.SOC = '66'
        ORDER BY 
            f2."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
        LIMIT 5
    );

SELECT 
    s.cds,
    sch."MailCity",
    (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore
FROM 
    satscores s
JOIN 
    schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE 
    (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500
LIMIT 20;

SELECT "Charter School Number", AvgScrWrite
FROM (
    SELECT s.cds, f."Charter School Number", s.AvgScrWrite,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND f."Charter School Number" IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY rank;

SELECT "County Name", "District Name", "School Name", "Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM frpm
ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT "County Name", "District Name", "School Name", "Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM frpm
ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT "County Name", COUNT(*) AS HighFRPMSchools
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt') AND "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5
GROUP BY "County Name";

SELECT "County Name", SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") AS TotalFreeMeals
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt')
GROUP BY "County Name";

SELECT "County", COUNT(*) AS CharterSchools
FROM schools

SELECT

FROM 
    (SELECT 
         g.Country,
         g.GasStationID
     FROM 
         transactions_1k t
     JOIN 
         gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
     JOIN 
         (SELECT 
              g.Country,
              g.Segment,
              t.ProductID,
              AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPrice
          FROM 
              transactions_1k t
          JOIN 
              gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID

              g.Country, g.Segment, t.ProductID) avg_prices

    Country;

    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    TopCombinations tc ON a1.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id 
                        AND a1.element = tc.element1 
                        AND a2.element = tc.element2;

WITH MostCommonCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        a1.element < a2.element
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id, a1.element, a2.element
),
TopCombinations AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule_id,
        element1,
        element2
    FROM 
        MostCommonCombinations
    WHERE 
        rn = 1
),
CommonCombinationBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS common_combination_bond_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN 
        TopCombinations tc ON a1.molecule_id = tc.molecule_id 
                            AND a1.element = tc.element1 
                            AND a2.element = tc.element2
),
TotalBondCount AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total_bond_count
    FROM 
        bond
)
SELECT 
    (common_combination_bond_count * 100.0 / total_bond_count) AS percentage
FROM 
    CommonCombinationBondCount, TotalBondCount;

WITH base_molecule_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        TRIM(SPLIT_PART(atom_id, '_', 1)) AS base_molecule_id
    FROM connected
),
carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT 
        base_molecule_ids.base_molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS atom_count
    FROM base_molecule_ids
    JOIN molecule ON base_molecule_ids.base_molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY base_molecule_ids.base_molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    base_molecule_id AS molecule_id,
    atom_count
FROM carcinogenic_molecules
ORDER BY atom_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  WHERE m.label = '+'
),
fluorine_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'f'
),
atoms_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bonds_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
bond_strength_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id,
         AVG(CASE b.bond_type
              WHEN '-' THEN 1
              WHEN '=' THEN 2
              WHEN '#' THEN 3
              ELSE 0
            END) AS bond_strength
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  (COUNT(DISTINCT cm.molecule_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT fm.molecule_id)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cm.molecule_id) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
  AVG(apm.atom_count) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NOT NULL THEN bp.with_fluorine ELSE NULL END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NULL THEN bp.without_fluorine ELSE NULL END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
  AVG(bs.bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
LEFT JOIN fluorine_molecules fm ON cm.molecule_id = fm.molecule_id
JOIN atoms_per_molecule apm ON cm.molecule_id = apm.molecule_id
JOIN (
  SELECT bp.molecule_id,
         CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NOT NULL THEN bp.bond_count ELSE NULL END AS with_fluorine,
         CASE WHEN fm.molecule_id IS NULL THEN bp.bond_count ELSE NULL END AS without_fluorine
  FROM bonds_per_molecule bp
  LEFT JOIN fluorine_molecules fm ON bp.molecule_id = fm.molecule_id
) bp ON cm.molecule_id = bp.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength_per_molecule bs ON cm.molecule_id = bs.molecule_id;
